content.title: Why Nova Minerals (ASX:NVA) Is Up After Securing US Antimony Refinery Site and Major Government Grant
content.summary: Nova Minerals Limited recently secured a land use permit for 42.81 acres near Port MacKenzie, advancing its proposed US antimony refinery with the backing of a US$43.4 million Department of War grant and aiming for first production within 24 months. This development highlights Nova’s emergence as the sole first-mover in domestic antimony production, bolstered by significant government support and positioning it as a potential key supplier to US military and industrial markets.
